DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 71 s. 2022 July 29, 2022 DIR. JUAN JOVIAN E. INGENIERO Regional Director, DILG-Region VI P. Aquino St., Fort San Pedro Iloilo City Dear RD Ingeniero. This pertains to your Memorandum dated May 25, 2022, requesting the Central Office's guidance on the following queries: I. Whether or not the SK Federation is allowed to have a special election coordinated with the MLGOO and COMELEC to elect their new Vice- President among all the members of the SK Federation; 2. Will the newly elected SK Federation — Vice President assume as the next SK Federation President following the rule on succession. Per representation, the current Municipal SK Federation President, Hon. Marc Franco V. Pajarito, was elected as Sangguniang Bayan Member during the May 09, 2022 elections. Along with this is the information that the SK Federation Vice President passed away last January 2020. Although it is silent as to whether the position of Vice President was filled up as a result of its permanent vacancy last January 2020, it can be inferred that there was no filling up. Hence, the queries. In both queries, the Department answers in the negative. In the first query, the provisions under Section 421, Item VIII of DILG-COMELEC-NYC JMC No. 2017-01 can no longer be applied. The SK Pederasyon President no longer assumed the position of an SK Chairperson due to his election as a member of the Sangguniang Bayan. As a result, a permanent vacancy exists in the position of SK Pederasyon President which cannot be filled up since the SK Pederasyon Vice- President died. In the second query, Section 41 of the subject JMC contemplates a situation where the vacancy is by virtue of the incumbent Vice President's automatic assumption' of the position of President due to the President's resignation, death, incapacity, removal from office or absence without leave. In this case, the Vice President died, hence Section 41 (a)(4) of the subject JMC finds no application. 1 Filling Up of Permanent 2 Special Election shall be held to elect the Vice President of the Pederasyon from among the officers of the Pederasyon "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Accordingly, the Department is of the opinion that the provisions under Rule IV3 of the said JMC shall apply to fill up the vacancies in the position of SK Pederasyon President and Vice-President. This opinion is rendered based on the facts presented and issued without prejudice to any contrary opinion of other government agencies and the courts. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: NGAN Underse tary for Local Government OUSLG/MLI/LLLS-LRALLD/ cip/gms cc: DIR. DENNIS D.
